home.hero_subheading: Describe the result you want — AI Creative Workstation takes care of the rest.
home.intent_placeholder: A cinematic portrait with dramatic lighting…
home.intent_hint: Paperclip or paste photos · Enter to continue
home.no_projects_desc: Projects you create or work on will appear here.
home.no_assets_desc: Images and characters you generate will appear here.
home.could_not_load_projects: Could not load your recent projects.
home.could_not_load_assets: Could not load your recent assets.

create.what_to_create: What do you want to create?
create.photos_lead: Add photos plus a scene description. Several photos cannot be glued into one frame yet — the model paints the scene from the prompt (faces will be similar in type, not a 1:1 copy).
create.intent_placeholder: e.g. Two boxers facing each other — keep the people from the photos
create.intent_hint: Clip or paste photos · Enter to send
create.no_model_installed: Download a model in Studio first.

error.title: Generation failed
error.sidecar_unavailable: The local AI engine is not responding. Restart the app and wait until the sidebar says Engine online.
error.mps_memory: The Mac GPU ran out of buffer for this job. Unload the model in Studio, pick Square, or attach fewer photos, then try again.
error.no_model: No active model. Open Studio, download a model, and click Use.

video.title: YouTube videos
video.lead: One job at a time. Start from an idea and build a storyboard, or take a screen recording and mix audio from your library.
video.no_library_audio: No tracks yet. Record or import them in Assets.
video.topic_placeholder: e.g. Why local AI image models finally work on a Mac…
video.clean_lead: Drop in a capture. The prompt tells the app what chrome to strip — browser UI, player controls, the stop button at the end.
video.clean_prompt_placeholder: Remove browser chrome, playback buttons, and the stop-recording UI at the end
video.timeline_lead: Describe timestamps: at 0:15 add the captured track; at 1:20 voiceover: your line.
video.timeline_placeholder:
at 0:05 add captured audio
на 1:20 озвучка: Привет

assets.title: Assets
assets.lead: Library of captures, voice sample, and source clips. Video mixes these tracks; Studio only shows whether a voice engine is ready.
assets.capture_lead: Record what the Mac is playing or the microphone. Saves WAV, MP3, or FLAC.
assets.audio_no_loopback: macOS did not attach system audio. Allow Screen Recording for this app, play sound, then try again. A virtual device like BlackHole also works.
assets.voice_lead: Record 10 seconds of your speech. Generate a voiceover in that voice (needs Coqui TTS in the sidecar).
assets.empty_library: Nothing here yet. Record system audio, the mic, or import a file.

threed.title: 3D
threed.lead: TripoSR builds a mesh from one photo. Prompt first draws a still with your image engine, then the same mesh step. Several photos: pick the best angle — this model is not multi-view.
threed.mode_hint_photo: Choose a picture of a single object on a simple background. Front-ish view works best.
threed.mode_hint_prompt: Describe the object. The app generates a square still (FLUX/SDXL), then TripoSR turns that still into a mesh.
threed.mode_hint_photos: TripoSR uses one view. Select the photo that shows the whole object most clearly.
threed.prompt_placeholder: e.g. a ceramic mug, white glaze, no background clutter
threed.photos_label: Photos — click the one to reconstruct
threed.no_reference: No photo yet. Choose a file, or generate a still in Create and it will appear here.
threed.no_photos: No photos yet. Choose one or more files, then click the thumbnail to use.
threed.need_image_engine: Prompt mode needs an image model (FLUX or SDXL) installed and set as active.
threed.generating_still_hint: Image engine is painting the reference. Mesh starts after that.
threed.generating_hint: TripoSR on CPU/MPS — first mesh load of the weights can take a minute.
threed.stage_load_weights_hint: First load of ~1.6 GB on CPU — later runs skip this
threed.still_failed: The still was generated but the file path is missing.
threed.engine_missing: TripoSR runtime is not installed in the sidecar.
threed.engine_setup: Run ./scripts/setup-triposr.sh once, then restart the app.
threed.weights_missing: TripoSR weights are not on disk yet (~1.6 GB).
threed.weights_hf_fallback: Weights are not cached locally yet. First run can pull ~1.6 GB from Hugging Face, or download in Studio for offline use.

create.uses: Create uses the image engine ({{engine}}). Stills land in Assets and can feed Video storyboards or 3D.

video.uses: From scratch, Video stills use the image engine ({{engine}}). Motion models are a separate Studio family — not required for montage from a recording.

threed.uses: 3D uses TripoSR from Studio. Image engine ({{engine}}) only supplies the reference still.

assets.uses: Assets hold stills, audio, and later meshes. Video mixes tracks from here. Image engine: {{engine}}.

studio.title: Studio
studio.lead: Engines are grouped by job. Image, video, 3D, and voice are not interchangeable.
studio.family_hint_image: SDXL follows English more reliably. FLUX handles Russian better. Used by Create and by Video stills.
studio.family_hint_video: Needed only for generated motion. Today's Video page stills use the Image family; montage from a recording uses ffmpeg.
studio.family_hint_3d: Image-to-mesh via TripoSR. Download weights here, then open 3D with a still from Create.
studio.family_hint_voice: Sample and TTS live in Assets. This tab only shows whether the voice engine is ready.
studio.no_models_family: Nothing installed in this family yet.
studio.note_ltx: Text-to-video. Separate pipeline from image models.
studio.note_wan: Smaller motion model. Still a video pipeline, not FLUX.
studio.note_hunyuan3d: Heavier 3D. Needs its own VRAM budget.
studio.not_in_ram_hint: Model files are on SSD but weights are not loaded into RAM. Unload appears after the first generation loads the model.
studio.unload_failed: Could not unload from RAM ({{reason}}). Restart the app if the badge stays on.
studio.unload_title: Unload from RAM. Files stay on disk and will reload on the next generation.
studio.unload_idle_title: Not in RAM — nothing to unload. Files stay on disk.
studio.delete_title: Delete files from disk and unload from RAM
studio.delete_confirm: Delete this model from disk? You will need to download it again.
studio.prompt_language_hint: SDXL follows English prompts more reliably. FLUX handles Russian better.
